''See also: [[Mount Samara Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Mount [[Samara]] is the tallest and most prominent of the four [[holy peaks]] located in [[Sacred Valley]]. A snow-covered mountain, it is distinguished by a massive halo of [[white light]] known as [[Samara's ring]] that circles its summit. This [[ring]], which was created by an expert centuries ago using bound [[light aura]], appears at sunset and vanishes at sunrise, ensuring that [[Sacred Valley]] never experiences a dark night. Because of this constant illumination, many [[sacred artists]] in the region specialize in light-aspect arts. The Heaven’s Glory School{{!}}Heaven's Glory School has claimed the peak, utilizing the [[ring]] to collect [[light aura]] even during moonless nights. The mountain features several notable landmarks, including a wide, polished white staircase that ascends the slopes in a straight line and the [[Ancestor's Tomb]], a massive square mausoleum situated on the mountainside. The terrain includes sparse patches of twisted trees and rocky slopes, though some areas contain rubble and remains following various conflicts. The mountain's characteristics have changed over time due to external influences; for instance, the [[ring]] has been known to change color or crackle with lightning when powered by different [[madra]] [[aspects]], such as the [[Storm Core]]. Additionally, the mountain has faced significant [[destruction]] from powerful entities, including being struck by a [[Titan]].}}

== Unsouled ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-01-unsouled|Located to the east, Mount [[Samara]] is the tallest of the four [[holy peaks]] and serves as the home to a heavenly guardian. The mountain's snow-blanketed slopes lead up to a summit encircled by a [[ring]] of pale [[white light]]. While [[Anses]] remains stationed upon the peak, [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] have been seen flying over the terrain and traveling down its steep sides.}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Located to the east near where [[Lindon]] landed, Mount [[Samara]] is a mountain characterized by a fading [[ring]] and a halo of light. As the [[Kazan clan]] reached the site, desperate crowds were seen pushing up its sides and dashing down its slopes. The eastern slopes became covered in rubble and bodies, with many more found in the foothills after the [[Titan]] potentially crashed through the mountain. Following [[Yerin]] hurtling into its side, the [[Dreadgod]] eventually moved away from the location as humans continued to flee down the mountain.}}
